test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

We lived a very __frugal__ life during our childhood.
solution:
The correct is: **Extravagant.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Frugal"** refers to being economical with money or resources; sparing or thrifty. (मितव्ययी)

 
 
• **For example: **Jane is always sensible about her finances. She believes in living a frugal lifestyle.
 
 
 
• The antonym would be a term that denotes the opposite behavior, which is spending freely or wastefully.&
